assets.prompt: Image 1 defines the palette and natural daylight, not buildings. Create a SQUARE full-bleed production terrain texture atlas, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows of 16 equally sized terrain variations for a medieval strategy WORLD MAP. No drawn grid, border, gutters, labels, objects, buildings, road networks, people, mountains, sky, perspective horizon or dramatic scene. Top-down orthographic map terrain texture, restrained muted sage grassland with cool-gray limestone patches and subtle dusty earth; quiet clearly differentiated broad natural shapes and sparse small clusters of overhead shrubs, readable at small tile sizes. Every variation reaches every edge with similar low-contrast grass so repeated edges remain continuous. Vary sparse grass density, small low rock patches, low shrubs and earth gently across all sixteen cells; no long cast shadows, round repeated stamps, blurry watercolor or photographic aerial image. Crisp hand-painted game texture, natural neutral daylight. Large quiet open surfaces support entity markers and labels. Atlas itself should be a cohesive sheet of sixteen subtle tile variations, not sixteen landscape thumbnails.
